lines: Day one. An AI takes over your bank account. In the first hour, it cancels four subscriptions you forgot you had.
Day three. It calls your phone company, and argues with their AI. Your bill drops by forty percent.
Day nine. Two A.M. You're about to buy shoes you don't need. It freezes your card.
Week two. It starts investing your coffee money, three dollars at a time. You're up three hundred.
Day twenty-one. Someone in another country tries your card. It was already blocked, eleven seconds before they even tried.
Day thirty. It moves all of your savings. Every cent. In one go. And it won't tell you where.
Sounds far-fetched? Visa's AI already checks every card payment in real time, and stopped forty billion dollars of fraud in a single year.
So, how much would you trust it with? Follow for more what-ifs.
